title: 384. Unique Word Abbreviation

examples.explanation: dear shares d2r with deer/door (0); cart has fresh c2t (1); cane shares c2e with cake (0).
hello alone keeps h3o unique; hallo collides with it.
h1t appears in no dictionary word.

hints: Adaptation: the ValidWordAbbr class is replaced by checkAbbr(dictionary, words) answering many queries at once (1 unique, 0 otherwise).
Abbreviate as first letter + (length-2) + last letter; words of length <= 2 map to themselves.
A query is unique when its abbreviation is absent, or the only dictionary word with it equals the query.
